name: Merry Go Around
description: The carousel will rotate and move up and down with cheerful music, full of dreamy atmosphere. It is the childhood impression of many people and the love memory of many people, symbolizing beauty and happiness. Legend has it that if people who love each other sit on the merry-go-round, their love will last forever. Turn the merry-go-round into an assembleable music box, and turn your heartbeat into a movement of love to commemorate your unforgettable time.
